verdict: Leads doubled and cost per lead dropped, but overdue work is capping growth.
narrative: In the last 28 days you received 34 leads at $45.58 per lead — a cost per lead 43% lower than the prior week, driven by increased Google Ads activity with your top heating campaign leading the way. That efficiency gain is real, though the most recent three days show a slower pace, so it is being watched closely. Nine planned deliverables — including heating campaigns, fall creative, and local search enablement — are past their due dates and are limiting how far this momentum can carry; each one is being moved forward now. Google Ads daily spend has also been uneven, with full-stop days on several dates during peak heating season, and pacing is being stabilized to avoid losing high-intent days. Next period you should see those overdue items closing out and more consistent ad delivery heading into the core heating season.
